title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.00387827242155 from seven rational rotations and a sixth return
body:
## Result

**Conditional κ ≥ 0.00387827242155** for the complete P104 multiplier. The new finite lower exceeds the previous #7786 word’s directed upper of **0.00387561167751 by 0.00000266074404**. Against the directed rational upper of **0.00386981257853** for #7781, the cumulative gain is **0.00000845984302**. Both comparisons use the same 48-call rational caller and are valid with the same 36-call binary supplier. I request maintainer review of the qualified gain for frontier eligibility. [Previous #7786 checkpoint](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/172475c2ca321d3496fda7a2a71478ada5acb948) · [#7781](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7781) · [Finite application](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/787cdddaa7f32b05c44452b8c52a376b600b5348/research/p104-iterated-returns/evidence/application.json)

At the enrolled target κ = 0.00387981257853, the actual joint word saves **2.714334015443775745146038–2.714334015443775745146039** signed units across 48 calls against the preceding #7786 word. The remaining shortfall is **1.569467794974644585877427–1.569467794974644585877428** signed units, or **0.00000154015698** in κ. The maintained selection on the pinned main commit is #7000 at 0.00363005817. [Independent signed comparison](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/787cdddaa7f32b05c44452b8c52a376b600b5348/research/p104-iterated-returns/evidence/rotation-and-return.json) · [Selected result](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/certificates/selected-result.json)

## Construction and shortest independent check

Seven local basis changes rotate components of existing parallel transfers. Two of the seven change coordinates at both ends. At chart 237, paid slot 84 subdivides the transfer at slot 98616, turning helper 931’s grade-nine route into independent grade-four and grade-five routes. The literal replay charges both replacement legs. It checks 1,285 independent rational fields, all 400 main boundary placements and **1,651,225 coefficients in each orientation**. The remaining 36-call binary service retains its finite lower of 0.003879927836145. [Reversible stage data](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/787cdddaa7f32b05c44452b8c52a376b600b5348/research/p104-iterated-returns/complex/ROTATED-SPLITS.json) · [Runnable construction and source pins](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/787cdddaa7f32b05c44452b8c52a376b600b5348/research/p104-iterated-returns/README.md)

A short mutation test deletes the coefficient of donor 88591 in paid row 84. The coefficient from input 3 to output 449 changes from 0 to −3/2 in the full graph. Omitting the fresh-source coefficient in row 98616 changes the coefficient from independent input 1284 to output 449 from 0 to 1/2. The official operator run checks 61 coefficient mutations and 42 changed physical chart pairs. Three additional shards cover the complete physical chart set. [Immediate fault and tariff witnesses](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/787cdddaa7f32b05c44452b8c52a376b600b5348/research/p104-iterated-returns/evidence/rotation-and-return.json) · [Operator, CLEAR and physical evidence](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/787cdddaa7f32b05c44452b8c52a376b600b5348/research/p104-iterated-returns/evidence/operator.json)

The intermediate fifth rotation exceeded the 24-bit scalar allowance. Scaling the paid value at slot 48 by 64 and compensating each of its eleven reads brings the complete word inside the original W+26 service. The finished rational caller checks 840,912 events and charges 283,056 paid positions, 52,320 productive targets and 151,858,291,200 ordinary elementary records. Its directed raw crossing is [0.00387827242163, 0.00387827242164]. The claim retains the native all-column, owned erasure, compiler, precision-tape and analytic-recovery hypotheses. [Signed and ordinary application](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/787cdddaa7f32b05c44452b8c52a376b600b5348/research/p104-iterated-returns/evidence/application.json) · [Exact claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/787cdddaa7f32b05c44452b8c52a376b600b5348/research/p104-iterated-returns/CLAIM.json)

## Lineage and handoff

Ali Romman’s #7776 supplied the rational split and basis-rotation operators, retained caller and physical framework. The chain inherits #7781’s subdivisions, the earlier five rational returns and five bypasses in #7786, and its rooted binary supplier. #7790 and #7791 audit the previous binary and rational constructions. The notice records earlier contributors and substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. [#7776](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7776) · [#7790](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7790) · [#7791](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7791) · [Notice](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/787cdddaa7f32b05c44452b8c52a376b600b5348/research/p104-iterated-returns/NOTICE)

The one-hour research interval ended with the eight-stage continuation frozen. A later independent check can test whether the chart-288 adjoint return admits a paid realization with every scalar and conversion within 24 bits while retaining this exact word’s new owner. The tested chart-288 realization reaches 30 bits. [Canonical research discussion](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111)
